title: Allah is more merciful than a mother to her child
arabic: لَلَّهُ أَرْحَمُ بِعِبَادِهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ بِوَلَدِهَا
latin: Wallahu arhamu bi 'ibadihi min hadhihi biwaladiha
translation: Allah is more merciful to His servants than this mother is to her child.
lesson: Whenever you feel distant, remember this. His mercy precedes His wrath. Return without shame.
